faq.a1: For any questions regarding redirecting your parcels, please contact your retailer or shipper.
faq.a10: We take great care in handling your parcel. However, if you receive a damaged parcel or you have not received your parcel and believe it may be lost, please contact your retailer or shipper.
faq.a11: If you would like to return your parcel, please contact your retailer or shipper for more information.
faq.a12: If you have not received your parcel, but the tracking status shows as "Delivered", please contact your retailer or shipper.
faq.a13: If you have an issue or concern with your parcel, please contact your retailer or shipper to make a claim.
faq.a14: A Maersk Tracking Number is the combination of numbers and letters that uniquely identifies your parcel for tracking. If you have ordered your product through a retailer or a shipper, they should be able to provide the Maersk Tracking Number.
faq.a15: Please make sure you entered the correct Maersk Tracking Number in the correct format. If your tracking number is still not working, please contact your retailer or shipper for support.
faq.a16: If you do not have a tracking number, contact your retailer or shipper.
faq.a17: A delivery exception means your parcel has experienced a delay or other transportation or delivery anomaly. The reason could include inclement weather, a natural disaster, a vehicle issue like a flat tire, or other circumstance or condition. We work hard to deliver every parcel as soon as possible, so a delivery exception doesn’t necessarily mean that your parcel will arrive late.
faq.a18: Tracking updates can take time, especially during transit periods or after parcel pickups. Domestic shipment statuses may take 24–48 hours to update. If you have an international shipment, take into consideration that tracking updates might take up to 3 days.
faq.a19: A delivery attempt may be unsuccessful for several reasons, including incorrect or incomplete address information, or access issues at the delivery location (such as gated communities). In some cases, safety concerns may also impact our ability to complete the delivery.
faq.a2: For any questions regarding cancelling your delivery, please contact your retailer or shipper.
faq.a20: If we’re unable to deliver your parcel, it will either be redirected to a nearby collection point for pickup, another delivery attempt will be made, or it will be returned to the sender.
faq.a21: If you are unable to retrieve your parcel due to a missing or invalid pickup code, please contact your last mile carrier for support.
faq.a22: If you have received a parcel that does not belong to you, please notify promptly to address the issue.
faq.a23: Yes, return shipments can be tracked using the tracking number provided at the time of drop-off. If you do not have this number, please contact your retailer or your last mile carrier for assistance.
faq.a24: For any adjustments to your delivery, for example an address change or a delivery time change, we recommend contacting your last mile carrier
faq.a25: Parcels at collection points are typically held for up to seven days. You will receive a notification upon arrival and a reminder before the parcel is returned to the sender.
faq.a3: For any questions regarding changes to your delivery address or  redirecting your parcels, please contact your retailer or shipper.
faq.a4: Currently, we do not offer the possibility to schedule a delivery time.
faq.a5: You can view the latest shipping status of your parcel, at any time, on our tracking page. The delivery date is subject to variables, including the actual date of receipt of the parcel for transport. Please contact your retailer or shipper for more information on your Expected Delivery Date.
faq.a6: Parcels to residences typically arrive between 6.00 a.m. and 9.00 p.m. in your local time zone.
faq.a7: Some shipments in select service areas may be eligible for deliveries on Saturdays between 6.00 a.m. and 9.00 p.m. and Sundays between 6.00 a.m. and 9.00 p.m.
faq.a8: A delivery attempt may be unsuccessful for several reasons, including incorrect or incomplete address information, or access issues at the delivery location (such as gated communities). In some cases, safety concerns may also impact our ability to complete the delivery.
faq.a9: Parcels may experience delays for several reasons, including adverse weather or unsafe delivery conditions, infrastructure congestion or incomplete address or delivery information. Additionally, unforeseen circumstances such as natural disasters or labor disruptions at shipping facilities can impact delivery times.
faq.aHtml26:
Delivery times depend on the service level selected. All timeframes refer to business days:

  • Domestic Standard: Estimated delivery within 2 to 7 business days
  • Domestic Expedited: Estimated delivery within 2 to 5 business days
  • International Standard (from Europe): Estimated delivery within 14 business days

Please note: Delivery times are estimates and may vary due to factors such as customs processing, weather conditions, or peak shipping periods.
faq.aOther10: For assistance with delayed, lost, or damaged parcels, please contact your retailer or your last mile carrier.
faq.aOther11: To initiate a return, please contact your retailer for detailed instructions and information on drop-off locations.
faq.aOther12: If the status indicates “Delivered” but you have not received your parcel, please contact your retailer or your last mile carrier for further investigation.
faq.aOther20: If we’re unable to deliver your parcel, it will either be redirected to a nearby collection point for pickup, another delivery attempt will be made, or it will be returned to the sender.
faq.aOther21: If you are unable to retrieve your parcel due to a missing or invalid pickup code, please contact your last mile carrier for support.
faq.aOther22: If you have received a parcel that does not belong to you, please notify your retailer promptly to address the issue.
faq.aOther23: Yes, return shipments can be tracked using the tracking number provided at the time of drop-off. If you do not have this number, please contact your retailer for assistance.
faq.aOther24: For any adjustments to your delivery, for example an address change or a delivery time change, we recommend contacting your last mile carrier
faq.aOther25: Parcels at collection points are typically held for up to seven days. You will receive a notification upon arrival and a reminder before the parcel is returned to the sender.
faq.aOther6: Deliveries generally occur between 8:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. local time.
faq.aOther7: In select service areas and for select last mile carriers, deliveries may be made on Saturdays between 9:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. local time.
faq.aOther8: Delivery requirements depend on the retailer or last mile carrier. For more details, contact them directly.

ocean.subtextBody1:
A container number is a unique number made up of 4 letters (container prefix) and 7 numbers printed on your booking forms and on the top right of every container door.

The Bill of Lading (BL) number consists of 9 characters. It can be found printed on your booking form.
ocean.subtextBody2:
Besides providing information on the current location of your freight container, a successful tracking enquiry will allow you to see:

  • Type and size of your container
  • Estimated date and time of your container's arrival at each milestone
  • All the stops including loading and discharge in your container's journey
